summary: Iteration 48 — Firebase Cloud Messaging (Web Push) integration for SPILOVEURE. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases green covering token upsert/delete, admin stats, admin broadcast to all/user/group, admin RBAC on all /admin/push/* endpoints, and static service worker delivery. Firebase Admin initializes cleanly at startup (no exception in supervisor logs, firebase_admin._apps populated because /admin/push/all returns success without a 500). Frontend: /(admin)/push renders after admin login, all documented data-testid are present, audience switching correctly reveals conditional filter fields, Envoyer maintenant button is initially disabled (aria-disabled=true, pointer-events:none, opacity 0.5) until title+body are provided. Service worker at /firebase-messaging-sw.js is served with correct content (firebase.initializeApp + onBackgroundMessage).
critical_code_review_comments: push_notifications.py: send_each_for_multicast is a synchronous Firebase Admin SDK call executed inside an async route — under high broadcast load it will block the FastAPI event loop. Consider offloading via anyio.to_thread.run_sync or a background task for large audiences.

_resolve_tokens: when user_filter is provided but resolves to zero user_ids, the current code falls through to `q = {"user_id": {"$in": []}}` which is fine (Mongo returns nothing), but the else branch (empty filter) queries ALL push_tokens — this is intentional for /admin/push/all but worth an explicit comment to avoid future regression.
TokenIn validator accepts platform up to 32 chars but does not restrict values (web / android / ios) — low priority.

SendIn.data uses dict[str, str] which is fine, but body enforcement (Pydantic strict=False) means FCM will reject non-string values silently converted; already stringified explicitly on line 143, good.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all testids present, disabled state correct, audience switching functional)

seed_data_creation: One transient TEST_push_* user created and its push_token row was deleted at end of test_register_token_upsert (verified deleted:1).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Push endpoints are stable and Firebase Admin initializes with service account at /app/backend/secrets/firebase-service-account.json. Reusable pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_push_notifications.py — remember to export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL when running pytest from CLI. Frontend UI is a react-native-web page at /push (Expo Router group (admin)); testIDs render as data-testid on web. Audience filter/user fields are conditionally mounted based on selected audience — expect count=0 for filter testids while audience='all'.
